name: feature-promo
title: Feature Promo
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A locked feature or an offer on a card: why it matters, what it gives and the call to action. Put `FeaturePromoContent` (with `FeaturePromoTitle`, one or more `FeaturePromoDescription`, `FeaturePromoBenefits` of `FeaturePromoBenefit` with an `icon` tile, and `FeaturePromoActions`), an optional `FeaturePromoMedia` and an optional `FeaturePromoGrid` inside `FeaturePromo`. `layout="split"` puts the media beside the content and hides it when the card is narrow; `layout="centered"` stacks everything in the middle. The grid spans the full width with one to three columns: choice cards, `Item`s with `href` for shortcuts, or cards that explain options. With a `FeaturePromoAcceptance` (a checkbox card), the buttons in `FeaturePromoActions` stay disabled until it is checked; uncontrolled (`defaultAccepted`) or controlled (`isAccepted` + `onAcceptedChange`). No background images or gradients: the media is a framed panel.
